Investment Counselors Of Maryland Cut Haynes International (HAYN) Holding by $4.27 Million; Stock Price Declined; Neumann Capital Management Holding in Metlife (MET) Decreased as Share Value Rose
May 29, 2018 - By Vivian Park
Neumann Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Metlife Inc (MET) by 81.61% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Neumann Capital Management Llc sold 30,530 shares as the company’s stock rose 0.25% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 6,880 shares of the finance company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $316,000, down from 37,410 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Neumann Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Metlife Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $46.07 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 4.93% or $2.35 during the last trading session, reaching $45.32. About 4.06M shares traded. MetLife, Inc. (NYSE:MET) has risen 4.50% since May 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 8.07% the S&P500.
